revisions.change_explanation: Initial chapter event: the Tang New Year audience as 古麻呂 reported it, labelled as a self-report and supported by the Tang-side notices.

content.summary: The New Year audience at 蓬萊宮含元殿 on the first day of the first month of 天寶十二載 (753), as 大伴古麻呂 reported it to the Japanese court: the envoys were seated below the Silla envoy, 古麻呂 objected, and the Tang general 呉懷實 moved the Silla envoy and placed the Japanese envoy above him.

time.source_expression: 大唐天寶十二載正月朔癸夘

places.note: The hall named in 古麻呂's report.

participants.note: Reported the audience to the Japanese court.
Moved the Silla envoy's seat after 古麻呂 objected.

content.editorial_notes: The account is 古麻呂's own report to the Japanese court and is published as a self-report, not as an independent record. The Silla envoy is named only by court in the report and has no actor record in this fixture. The Tang histories record the embassy's tribute and 朝衡's return at year granularity and do not describe the audience.

claims.statement: 古麻呂 reported to the Japanese court that the New Year audience was held at 蓬萊宮含元殿 on 大唐天寶十二載正月朔癸夘.

locator.value: 卷第十九 天平勝寶六年正月丙寅

citations.quoted_text: 古麻呂奏曰。大唐天寳十二載。歳在癸巳正月朔癸夘。百官諸蕃朝賀。天子於蓬莱宮含元殿受朝。

claims.statement: The Tang court record reports that in the twelfth year of 天寶 the Japanese sent tribute again.

locator.value: 卷199上 東夷 日本國（天寶十二年，又遣使貢）

claims.statement: The Song history reports that 朝衡 returned to the Tang court in 天寶十二載.

locator.value: 卷220 東夷 日本（天寶十二載，朝衡復入朝）

claims.statement: The same report records the seating-order dispute and 呉懷實's intervention.

locator.value: 卷第十九 天平勝寶六年正月丙寅
